column1: # Source: Statistics Canada IMDB (Longitudinal Immigration Database);
#         IRCC annual reports; UN WPP migrant age patterns for projections.
# age_group: lower bound of 5-year band (e.g. 0 = ages 0-4
# share: fraction of all immigrants of that sex in this age band
#        (M shares sum to 1.0; F shares sum to 1.0 independently)
# Male/Female split of total immigrants assumed ~50/50 throughout
#   - Strong working-age peak (25-39) reflects economic-class dominance
#   - 65+ share small (~2-4%) but rising in later projections
#   - Refugee periods shift age distribution younger
